title: Arrays
summary: Creating arrays with new and initializers, indexing and length, default values, looping over arrays, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, the java.util.Arrays helpers (toString, sort, fill, copyOf, equals, binarySearch), copying versus sharing, two-dimensional arrays, and classic array algorithms.

cards.q: What are the valid indexes of an array of length 5?
Why does System.out.println(array) not show the values?
cards.a: Arrays do not have a readable toString; use Arrays.toString(array).
